        },
        {
          "text": "снова",
          "start": 1.509,
          "end": 1.869
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 1.916,
          "end": 1.985
        },
        {
          "text": "кону.",
          "start": 2.043,
          "end": 2.531
        },
        {
          "text": "«Кто",
          "start": 2.682,
          "end": 3.019
        },
        {
          "text": "хочет",
          "start": 3.1,
          "end": 3.402
        },
        {
          "text": "стать",
          "start": 3.448,
          "end": 3.692
        },
        {
          "text": "миллионером».",
          "start": 3.738,
          "end": 4.563
        },
        {
          "text": "Главный",
          "start": 5.004,
          "end": 5.492
        },
        {
          "text": "приз",
          "start": 5.55,
          "end": 5.759
        },
        {
          "text": "прежний",
          "start": 5.828,
          "end": 6.327
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 6.478,
          "end": 6.618
        },
        {
          "text": "продолжение",
          "start": 6.769,
          "end": 7.488
        },
        {
          "text": "совещания.",
          "start": 7.558,
          "end": 8.731
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.КОНТЕКСТ",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 831,
      "textHash": "de30f555eb4c9b8c776f04f1d3a5ca0cd702a7739e3e0737444e9d391a9bc2de",
      "duration": 6.4087,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/de30f555eb4c9b8c776f04f1.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "de30f555eb4c9b8c776f04f1d3a5ca0cd702a7739e3e0737444e9d391a9bc2de",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Пока",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.395
        },
        {
          "text": "Эдик",
          "start": 0.511,
          "end": 0.824
        },
        {
          "text": "вёл",
          "start": 0.882,
          "end": 1.091
        },
        {
          "text": "Househunt",
          "start": 1.184,
          "end": 1.73
        },
        {
          "text": "к",
          "start": 1.765,
          "end": 1.8
        },
        {
          "text": "сдаче,",
          "start": 1.858,
          "end": 2.392
        },
        {
          "text": "клиент",
          "start": 2.485,
          "end": 2.914
        },
        {
          "text": "уточнял,",
          "start": 2.984,
          "end": 3.518
        },
        {
          "text": "во",
          "start": 3.541,
          "end": 3.646
        },
        {
          "text": "что",
          "start": 3.68,
          "end": 3.913
        },
        {
          "text": "именно",
          "start": 4.005,
          "end": 4.447
        },
        {
          "text": "должен",
          "start": 4.516,
          "end": 4.934
        },
        {
          "text": "играть",
          "start": 4.992,
          "end": 5.294
        },
        {
          "text": "пользователь.",
          "start": 5.341,
          "end": 6.409
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ВОПРОС",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 835,
      "textHash": "d770c5501fa71278852fd58fce76b4f89c34e082e9a8122f4d192c44590561ad",
      "duration": 4.226,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/d770c5501fa71278852fd58f.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "d770c5501fa71278852fd58fce76b4f89c34e082e9a8122f4d192c44590561ad",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Какую",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.464
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 0.58,
          "end": 0.743
        },
        {
          "text": "этих",
          "start": 0.859,
          "end": 1.033
        },
        {
          "text": "механик",
          "start": 1.115,
          "end": 1.637
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 1.765,
          "end": 1.8
        },
        {
          "text": "итоге",
          "start": 1.892,
          "end": 2.252
        },
        {
          "text": "вырезали",
          "start": 2.322,
          "end": 2.891
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 2.949,
          "end": 3.123
        },
        {
          "text": "Househunt?",
          "start": 3.216,
          "end": 4.226
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ВАРИАНТЫ",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 846,
      "textHash": "c08e01c076c44a79ffd560fdceb67f8b057fac41a56950aad80264438df5578c",
      "duration": 11.0063,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/c08e01c076c44a79ffd560fd.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "c08e01c076c44a79ffd560fdceb67f8b057fac41a56950aad80264438df5578c",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Купить",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.464
        },
        {
          "text": "дом",
          "start": 0.499,
          "end": 0.708
        },
        {
          "text": "вслепую,",
          "start": 0.743,
          "end": 1.509
        },
        {
          "text": "под",
          "start": 1.567,
          "end": 1.765
        },
        {
          "text": "тентом.",
          "start": 1.834,
          "end": 2.461
        },
        {
          "text": "Снять",
          "start": 2.902,
          "end": 3.367
        },
        {
          "text": "тент",
          "start": 3.425,
          "end": 3.68
        },
        {
          "text": "свайпом.",
          "start": 3.715,
          "end": 4.435
        },
        {
          "text": "Выбрать",
          "start": 4.946,
          "end": 5.41
        },
        {
          "text": "покупку",
          "start": 5.457,
          "end": 6.014
        },
        {
          "text": "по",
          "start": 6.084,
          "end": 6.177
        },
        {
          "text": "открытой",
          "start": 6.2,
          "end": 6.618
        },
        {
          "text": "цене.",
          "start": 6.711,
          "end": 7.268
        },
        {
          "text": "Получить",
          "start": 7.709,
          "end": 8.208
        },
        {
          "text": "бонусы",
          "start": 8.266,
          "end": 8.754
        },
        {
          "text": "к",
          "start": 8.789,
          "end": 8.835
        },
        {
          "text": "стоимости",
          "start": 8.893,
          "end": 9.567
        },
        {
          "text": "после",
          "start": 9.636,
          "end": 9.996
        },
        {
          "text": "покупки.",
          "start": 10.043,
          "end": 11.006
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ПЕРВЫЙ_ВЫБОР",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 856,
      "textHash": "d44f7d8aa2b5b45781f4c96fb665013652065855fef6aaa4581ff194b36fe733",
      "duration": 3.1579,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/d44f7d8aa2b5b45781f4c96f.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "d44f7d8aa2b5b45781f4c96fb665013652065855fef6aaa4581ff194b36fe733",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Верно.",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.697
        },
        {
          "text": "Но",
          "start": 0.871,
          "end": 1.022
        },
        {
          "text": "вы",
          "start": 1.057,
          "end": 1.138
        },
        {
          "text": "пока",
          "start": 1.196,
          "end": 1.405
        },
        {
          "text": "вырезали",
          "start": 1.451,
          "end": 1.869
        },
        {
          "text": "слишком",
          "start": 1.916,
          "end": 2.345
        },
        {
          "text": "мало.",
          "start": 2.415,
          "end": 3.158
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.РАСКРЫТИЕ",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 862,
      "textHash": "db24783771448566a806e17a640df325b09285147ab2c8c9673304c8958fb19d",
      "duration": 5.2941,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/db24783771448566a806e17a.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "db24783771448566a806e17a640df325b09285147ab2c8c9673304c8958fb19d",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Вырезали",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.569
        },
        {
          "text": "всё",
          "start": 0.604,
          "end": 0.801
        },
        {
          "text": "перечисленное.",
          "start": 0.882,
          "end": 1.881
        },
        {
          "text": "Даже",
          "start": 1.962,
          "end": 2.287
        },
        {
          "text": "то,",
          "start": 2.345,
          "end": 2.473
        },
        {
          "text": "что",
          "start": 2.508,
          "end": 2.635
        },
        {
          "text": "успели",
          "start": 2.682,
          "end": 3.042
        },
        {
          "text": "добавить",
          "start": 3.1,
          "end": 3.529
        },
        {
          "text": "по",
          "start": 3.576,
          "end": 3.669
        },
        {
          "text": "предыдущим",
          "start": 3.704,
          "end": 4.342
        },
        {
          "text": "правкам.",
          "start": 4.4,
          "end": 5.294
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ИСТОРИЯ.1",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 875,
      "textHash": "6c46e6e468c6bc98efc9040ecb9c8b44914c99f7daaecf097db3281faec71e0b",
      "duration": 15.7896,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/6c46e6e468c6bc98efc9040e.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "6c46e6e468c6bc98efc9040ecb9c8b44914c99f7daaecf097db3281faec71e0b",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "В",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.104
        },
        {
          "text": "Househunt",
          "start": 0.221,
          "end": 0.929
        },
        {
          "text": "можно",
          "start": 1.045,
          "end": 1.382
        },
        {
          "text": "было",
          "start": 1.428,
          "end": 1.614
        },
        {
          "text": "купить",
          "start": 1.649,
          "end": 1.985
        },
        {
          "text": "дом,",
          "start": 2.02,
          "end": 2.438
        },
        {
          "text": "не",
          "start": 2.531,
          "end": 2.717
        },
        {
          "text": "видя,",
          "start": 2.763,
          "end": 3.042
        },
        {
          "text": "что",
          "start": 3.088,
          "end": 3.251
        },
        {
          "text": "скрывается",
          "start": 3.297,
          "end": 3.959
        },
        {
          "text": "под",
          "start": 4.017,
          "end": 4.156
        },
        {
          "text": "строительным",
          "start": 4.203,
          "end": 4.853
        },
        {
          "text": "тентом.",
          "start": 4.934,
          "end": 5.619
        },
        {
          "text": "Эдик",
          "start": 6.92,
          "end": 7.221
        },
        {
          "text": "предложил",
          "start": 7.291,
          "end": 7.814
        },
        {
          "text": "дать",
          "start": 7.895,
          "end": 8.069
        },
        {
          "text": "покупателю",
          "start": 8.127,
          "end": 8.963
        },
        {
          "text": "самому",
          "start": 9.091,
          "end": 9.567
        },
        {
          "text": "снять",
          "start": 9.625,
          "end": 9.961
        },
        {
          "text": "тент",
          "start": 9.985,
          "end": 10.252
        },
        {
          "text": "свайпом",
          "start": 10.298,
          "end": 10.867
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 11.018,
          "end": 11.146
        },
        {
          "text": "чтобы",
          "start": 11.297,
          "end": 11.552
        },
        {
          "text": "с",
          "start": 11.587,
          "end": 11.61
        },
        {
          "text": "последствиями",
          "start": 11.668,
          "end": 12.446
        },
        {
          "text": "своего",
          "start": 12.492,
          "end": 12.841
        },
        {
          "text": "выбора",
          "start": 12.875,
          "end": 13.212
        },
        {
          "text": "тот",
          "start": 13.27,
          "end": 13.444
        },
        {
          "text": "знакомился",
          "start": 13.502,
          "end": 14.164
        },
        {
          "text": "собственноручно.",
          "start": 14.257,
          "end": 15.79
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ИСТОРИЯ.2",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 881,
      "textHash": "57b3aeac2863213d86840e8c3b950edf12651730067acca219058f340984a958",
      "duration": 10.5419,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/57b3aeac2863213d86840e8c.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "57b3aeac2863213d86840e8c3b950edf12651730067acca219058f340984a958",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Клиент",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.522
        },
        {
          "text": "попросил",
          "start": 0.58,
          "end": 1.08
        },
        {
          "text": "убрать",
          "start": 1.115,
          "end": 1.405
        },
        {
          "text": "тент.",
          "start": 1.428,
          "end": 1.974
        },
        {
          "text": "Эдик",
          "start": 2.148,
          "end": 2.461
        },
        {
          "text": "уже",
          "start": 2.519,
          "end": 2.67
        },
        {
          "text": "успел",
          "start": 2.728,
          "end": 3.065
        },
        {
          "text": "установить",
          "start": 3.135,
          "end": 3.622
        },
        {
          "text": "с",
          "start": 3.657,
          "end": 3.68
        },
        {
          "text": "ним",
          "start": 3.75,
          "end": 3.878
        },
        {
          "text": "родственные",
          "start": 3.947,
          "end": 4.563
        },
        {
          "text": "отношения",
          "start": 4.632,
          "end": 5.352
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 5.445,
          "end": 5.492
        },
        {
          "text": "написал:",
          "start": 5.561,
          "end": 6.281
        },
        {
          "text": "«капец,",
          "start": 6.56,
          "end": 7.477
        },
        {
          "text": "я",
          "start": 7.546,
          "end": 7.639
        },
        {
          "text": "уже",
          "start": 7.697,
          "end": 7.883
        },
        {
          "text": "полюбил",
          "start": 7.93,
          "end": 8.371
        },
        {
          "text": "этот",
          "start": 8.44,
          "end": 8.615
        },
        {
          "text": "тент,",
          "start": 8.638,
          "end": 8.975
        },
        {
          "text": "как",
          "start": 8.998,
          "end": 9.149
        },
        {
          "text": "родного",
          "start": 9.23,
          "end": 9.636
        },
        {
          "text": "брата».",
          "start": 9.683,
          "end": 10.542
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ИСТОРИЯ.3",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 888,
      "textHash": "5b14e01807f943d406be383e2d8a12dfc12350e7cd1b4187d6c410c3f180770b",
      "duration": 19.3654,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/5b14e01807f943d406be383e.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "5b14e01807f943d406be383e2d8a12dfc12350e7cd1b4187d6c410c3f180770b",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "В",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.093
        },
        {
          "text": "следующей",
          "start": 0.151,
          "end": 0.72
        },
        {
          "text": "версии",
          "start": 0.755,
          "end": 1.173
        },
        {
          "text": "дома",
          "start": 1.242,
          "end": 1.602
        },
        {
          "text": "показывали",
          "start": 1.672,
          "end": 2.368
        },
        {
          "text": "с",
          "start": 2.415,
          "end": 2.438
        },
        {
          "text": "ценами,",
          "start": 2.589,
          "end": 3.228
        },
        {
          "text": "а",
          "start": 3.437,
          "end": 3.518
        },
        {
          "text": "после",
          "start": 3.564,
          "end": 3.855
        },
        {
          "text": "покупки",
          "start": 3.901,
          "end": 4.458
        },
        {
          "text": "раскрывали",
          "start": 4.574,
          "end": 5.271
        },
        {
          "text": "бонусы",
          "start": 5.341,
          "end": 5.817
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 5.875,
          "end": 5.933
        },
        {
          "text": "штрафы,",
          "start": 6.002,
          "end": 6.676
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 6.827,
          "end": 6.978
        },
        {
          "text": "которых",
          "start": 7.036,
          "end": 7.384
        },
        {
          "text": "складывалась",
          "start": 7.43,
          "end": 8.092
        },
        {
          "text": "цена",
          "start": 8.127,
          "end": 8.406
        },
        {
          "text": "продажи.",
          "start": 8.452,
          "end": 9.253
        },
        {
          "text": "Эту",
          "start": 10.205,
          "end": 10.461
        },
        {
          "text": "схему",
          "start": 10.519,
          "end": 10.879
        },
        {
          "text": "предложил",
          "start": 10.925,
          "end": 11.413
        },
        {
          "text": "сам",
          "start": 11.482,
          "end": 11.703
        },
        {
          "text": "клиент",
          "start": 11.773,
          "end": 12.295
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 12.469,
          "end": 12.794
        },
        {
          "text": "у",
          "start": 12.945,
          "end": 13.015
        },
        {
          "text": "живого",
          "start": 13.096,
          "end": 13.549
        },
        {
          "text": "билда",
          "start": 13.607,
          "end": 14.083
        },
        {
          "text": "появился",
          "start": 14.327,
          "end": 15
        },
        {
          "text": "орган,",
          "start": 15.093,
          "end": 15.627
        },
        {
          "text": "совместимость",
          "start": 15.836,
          "end": 16.649
        },
        {
          "text": "которого",
          "start": 16.707,
          "end": 17.252
        },
        {
          "text": "подтвердил",
          "start": 17.496,
          "end": 18.158
        },
        {
          "text": "сам",
          "start": 18.239,
          "end": 18.483
        },
        {
          "text": "хирург.",
          "start": 18.553,
          "end": 19.365
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ИСТОРИЯ.4",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 892,
      "textHash": "c9226ffc5364c92a9fa3beea91e9b34ba13ccdfa41640c2bcbc8e22e9e610514",
      "duration": 11.4242,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/c9226ffc5364c92a9fa3beea.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "c9226ffc5364c92a9fa3beea91e9b34ba13ccdfa41640c2bcbc8e22e9e610514",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Следующими",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.731
        },
        {
          "text": "правками",
          "start": 0.778,
          "end": 1.231
        },
        {
          "text": "под",
          "start": 1.277,
          "end": 1.428
        },
        {
          "text": "нож",
          "start": 1.498,
          "end": 1.66
        },
        {
          "text": "отправилась",
          "start": 1.73,
          "end": 2.264
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 2.299,
          "end": 2.322
        },
        {
          "text": "пересадка.",
          "start": 2.357,
          "end": 3.123
        },
        {
          "text": "Из",
          "start": 3.297,
          "end": 3.483
        },
        {
          "text": "сосуда",
          "start": 3.529,
          "end": 4.005
        },
        {
          "text": "выпотрошили",
          "start": 4.063,
          "end": 4.714
        },
        {
          "text": "расчёт",
          "start": 4.748,
          "end": 5.085
        },
        {
          "text": "стоимости",
          "start": 5.132,
          "end": 5.619
        },
        {
          "text": "после",
          "start": 5.677,
          "end": 5.956
        },
        {
          "text": "покупки",
          "start": 6.002,
          "end": 6.513
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 6.548,
          "end": 6.664
        },
        {
          "text": "оставили",
          "start": 6.745,
          "end": 7.152
        },
        {
          "text": "одноклеточный",
          "start": 7.187,
          "end": 7.953
        },
        {
          "text": "рефлекс:",
          "start": 7.988,
          "end": 8.649
        },
        {
          "text": "«Угадай,",
          "start": 8.766,
          "end": 9.683
        },
        {
          "text": "какой",
          "start": 9.741,
          "end": 10.112
        },
        {
          "text": "дом",
          "start": 10.194,
          "end": 10.391
        },
        {
          "text": "дороже?».",
          "start": 10.472,
          "end": 11.424
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-02.ИСТОРИЯ.5",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 900,
      "textHash": "22883b281c85678bdb3603c9ba75497f5bb8b2fabc1a0f1b128606e4dcc69664",
      "duration": 6.5016,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/22883b281c85678bdb3603c9.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "22883b281c85678bdb3603c9ba75497f5bb8b2fabc1a0f1b128606e4dcc69664",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Эдик",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.36
        },
        {
          "text": "проводил",
          "start": 0.43,
          "end": 0.813
        },
        {
          "text": "оставшиеся",
          "start": 0.871,
          "end": 1.451
        },
        {
          "text": "механики",
          "start": 1.509,
          "end": 1.974
        },
        {
          "text": "коротким",
          "start": 2.032,
          "end": 2.461
        },
        {
          "text": "некрологом:",
          "start": 2.508,
          "end": 3.297
        },
        {
          "text": "«Капец,",
          "start": 3.379,
          "end": 4.4
        },
        {
          "text": "был",
          "start": 4.458,
          "end": 4.656
        },
        {
          "text": "же",
          "start": 4.748,
          "end": 4.865
        },
        {
          "text": "нормальный",
          "start": 4.923,
          "end": 5.468
        },
        {
          "text": "плейбл».",
          "start": 5.526,
          "end": 6.502
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P001",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 924,
      "textHash": "bbf04e607512db1ee7901a839b735b300b5df9c045bcafa09ff8e4a3be7fafe9",
      "duration": 8.3127,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/bbf04e607512db1ee7901a83.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "bbf04e607512db1ee7901a839b735b300b5df9c045bcafa09ff8e4a3be7fafe9",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Ауспексы",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.813
        },
        {
          "text": "дальнего",
          "start": 0.882,
          "end": 1.265
        },
        {
          "text": "сканирования",
          "start": 1.312,
          "end": 2.113
        },
        {
          "text": "воют",
          "start": 2.194,
          "end": 2.519
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 2.577,
          "end": 2.647
        },
        {
          "text": "пределе:",
          "start": 2.694,
          "end": 3.402
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 3.553,
          "end": 3.669
        },
        {
          "text": "внешних",
          "start": 3.715,
          "end": 4.156
        },
        {
          "text": "рубежах",
          "start": 4.214,
          "end": 4.609
        },
        {
          "text": "показались",
          "start": 4.656,
          "end": 5.201
        },
        {
          "text": "боевые",
          "start": 5.248,
          "end": 5.608
        },
        {
          "text": "флотилии",
          "start": 5.666,
          "end": 6.2
        },
        {
          "text": "Клиентархов-правконосцев.",
          "start": 6.269,
          "end": 8.313
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P002",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 928,
      "textHash": "9ca1ec0b95c64f1724df1140d5636d2012d7c228e1bd6fb58159e4a51eaa5e03",
      "duration": 10.5419,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/9ca1ec0b95c64f1724df1140.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "9ca1ec0b95c64f1724df1140d5636d2012d7c228e1bd6fb58159e4a51eaa5e03",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Первыми",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.511
        },
        {
          "text": "по",
          "start": 0.557,
          "end": 0.65
        },
        {
          "text": "титановой",
          "start": 0.685,
          "end": 1.196
        },
        {
          "text": "обшивке",
          "start": 1.265,
          "end": 1.741
        },
        {
          "text": "Ковчега",
          "start": 1.788,
          "end": 2.252
        },
        {
          "text": "ударили",
          "start": 2.31,
          "end": 2.728
        },
        {
          "text": "Клиентархи",
          "start": 2.775,
          "end": 3.518
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 3.587,
          "end": 3.715
        },
        {
          "text": "Королевского",
          "start": 3.785,
          "end": 4.447
        },
        {
          "text": "Сундука",
          "start": 4.493,
          "end": 5.132
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 5.248,
          "end": 5.364
        },
        {
          "text": "владыки",
          "start": 5.515,
          "end": 6.107
        },
        {
          "text": "выжженных",
          "start": 6.165,
          "end": 6.78
        },
        {
          "text": "пустошей,",
          "start": 6.838,
          "end": 7.639
        },
        {
          "text": "которых",
          "start": 7.674,
          "end": 8.022
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 8.092,
          "end": 8.15
        },
        {
          "text": "корабле",
          "start": 8.197,
          "end": 8.568
        },
        {
          "text": "смертельно",
          "start": 8.615,
          "end": 9.23
        },
        {
          "text": "боятся",
          "start": 9.265,
          "end": 9.764
        },
        {
          "text": "злить.",
          "start": 9.822,
          "end": 10.542
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P003",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 932,
      "textHash": "33cf563583261cf7c84efa114365f5c5b241b3889b0483a7268c18c9fbb1bcad",
      "duration": 9.4737,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/33cf563583261cf7c84efa11.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "33cf563583261cf7c84efa114365f5c5b241b3889b0483a7268c18c9fbb1bcad",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Шквал",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.464
        },
        {
          "text": "их",
          "start": 0.58,
          "end": 0.708
        },
        {
          "text": "тяжёлых",
          "start": 0.778,
          "end": 1.207
        },
        {
          "text": "торпед",
          "start": 1.277,
          "end": 1.649
        },
        {
          "text": "правок",
          "start": 1.718,
          "end": 2.101
        },
        {
          "text": "сотряс",
          "start": 2.183,
          "end": 2.601
        },
        {
          "text": "переборки",
          "start": 2.67,
          "end": 3.216
        },
        {
          "text": "настолько",
          "start": 3.274,
          "end": 3.796
        },
        {
          "text": "убедительно,",
          "start": 3.82,
          "end": 4.714
        },
        {
          "text": "что",
          "start": 4.888,
          "end": 5.039
        },
        {
          "text": "вся",
          "start": 5.097,
          "end": 5.271
        },
        {
          "text": "боевая",
          "start": 5.352,
          "end": 5.7
        },
        {
          "text": "сводка",
          "start": 5.77,
          "end": 6.246
        },
        {
          "text": "Мамусина",
          "start": 6.316,
          "end": 7.024
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 7.117,
          "end": 7.198
        },
        {
          "text": "рубку",
          "start": 7.291,
          "end": 7.674
        },
        {
          "text": "свелась",
          "start": 7.732,
          "end": 8.162
        },
        {
          "text": "к",
          "start": 8.22,
          "end": 8.243
        },
        {
          "text": "одной",
          "start": 8.301,
          "end": 8.557
        },
        {
          "text": "фразе:",
          "start": 8.626,
          "end": 9.474
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P004",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 935,
      "textHash": "fa13efcb0896be821033346ef89a2fe2da6fddb5de3971c360be7c372de83472",
      "duration": 2.9257,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/fa13efcb0896be821033346e.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "fa13efcb0896be821033346ef89a2fe2da6fddb5de3971c360be7c372de83472",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "«Бля,",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.476
        },
        {
          "text": "там",
          "start": 0.592,
          "end": 0.766
        },
        {
          "text": "какое-то",
          "start": 0.824,
          "end": 1.173
        },
        {
          "text": "мясо",
          "start": 1.231,
          "end": 1.591
        },
        {
          "text": "щас",
          "start": 1.649,
          "end": 1.869
        },
        {
          "text": "происходит».",
          "start": 1.939,
          "end": 2.926
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P005",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 938,
      "textHash": "2542750e60312ba1fa6f1bab6c0195e7b45e1f49e91598d6e9f786c88a267006",
      "duration": 11.0063,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/2542750e60312ba1fa6f1bab.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "2542750e60312ba1fa6f1bab6c0195e7b45e1f49e91598d6e9f786c88a267006",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Владыка",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.546
        },
        {
          "text": "Сундука",
          "start": 0.592,
          "end": 1.219
        },
        {
          "text": "вдохнул",
          "start": 1.335,
          "end": 1.788
        },
        {
          "text": "тестовую",
          "start": 1.869,
          "end": 2.357
        },
        {
          "text": "дозу",
          "start": 2.426,
          "end": 2.67
        },
        {
          "text": "Плейриума",
          "start": 2.717,
          "end": 3.332
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 3.413,
          "end": 3.483
        },
        {
          "text": "обнаружил",
          "start": 3.541,
          "end": 4.017
        },
        {
          "text": "брак:",
          "start": 4.087,
          "end": 4.586
        },
        {
          "text": "подопытные",
          "start": 4.865,
          "end": 5.631
        },
        {
          "text": "игроки",
          "start": 5.689,
          "end": 6.142
        },
        {
          "text": "внутри",
          "start": 6.188,
          "end": 6.583
        },
        {
          "text": "Тап-капкана",
          "start": 6.653,
          "end": 7.419
        },
        {
          "text": "подозрительно",
          "start": 7.477,
          "end": 8.115
        },
        {
          "text": "легко",
          "start": 8.15,
          "end": 8.464
        },
        {
          "text": "выживали",
          "start": 8.51,
          "end": 8.963
        },
        {
          "text": "без",
          "start": 9.021,
          "end": 9.183
        },
        {
          "text": "единого",
          "start": 9.276,
          "end": 9.659
        },
        {
          "text": "черепка",
          "start": 9.718,
          "end": 10.089
        },
        {
          "text": "смерти.",
          "start": 10.136,
          "end": 11.006
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P006",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 941,
      "textHash": "a7c31889120518d834f822f7ef28606b8b5fac9072950eef5875da2f9eb9ef2e",
      "duration": 6.6409,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/a7c31889120518d834f822f7.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "a7c31889120518d834f822f7ef28606b8b5fac9072950eef5875da2f9eb9ef2e",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Клиентарх",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.708
        },
        {
          "text": "вынес",
          "start": 0.778,
          "end": 1.045
        },
        {
          "text": "вердикт:",
          "start": 1.115,
          "end": 1.718
        },
        {
          "text": "«филлинга",
          "start": 1.765,
          "end": 2.496
        },
        {
          "text": "0»",
          "start": 2.554,
          "end": 2.972
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 3.03,
          "end": 3.17
        },
        {
          "text": "ведь",
          "start": 3.239,
          "end": 3.425
        },
        {
          "text": "если",
          "start": 3.46,
          "end": 3.692
        },
        {
          "text": "никто",
          "start": 3.727,
          "end": 3.936
        },
        {
          "text": "не",
          "start": 3.982,
          "end": 4.04
        },
        {
          "text": "погибает,",
          "start": 4.075,
          "end": 4.644
        },
        {
          "text": "игра",
          "start": 4.69,
          "end": 4.969
        },
        {
          "text": "не",
          "start": 5.027,
          "end": 5.143
        },
        {
          "text": "приносит",
          "start": 5.19,
          "end": 5.712
        },
        {
          "text": "эмоций.",
          "start": 5.747,
          "end": 6.641
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P007",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 945,
      "textHash": "c1bc93d5ff1ac2fb6c04ef58748c73459834dedf781cbe1821aaececf9123cfd",
      "duration": 7.7555,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/c1bc93d5ff1ac2fb6c04ef58.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "c1bc93d5ff1ac2fb6c04ef58748c73459834dedf781cbe1821aaececf9123cfd",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Кузнецы",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.639
        },
        {
          "text": "плейблов",
          "start": 0.673,
          "end": 1.173
        },
        {
          "text": "послушно",
          "start": 1.242,
          "end": 1.73
        },
        {
          "text": "вскрыли",
          "start": 1.765,
          "end": 2.125
        },
        {
          "text": "обшивку,",
          "start": 2.171,
          "end": 2.844
        },
        {
          "text": "выкрутили",
          "start": 3.019,
          "end": 3.611
        },
        {
          "text": "генератор",
          "start": 3.657,
          "end": 4.122
        },
        {
          "text": "страданий",
          "start": 4.168,
          "end": 4.667
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 4.714,
          "end": 4.783
        },
        {
          "text": "максимум",
          "start": 4.853,
          "end": 5.399
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 5.677,
          "end": 5.793
        },
        {
          "text": "вернули",
          "start": 5.84,
          "end": 6.281
        },
        {
          "text": "черепок",
          "start": 6.327,
          "end": 6.769
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 6.803,
          "end": 6.827
        },
        {
          "text": "цикл.",
          "start": 6.943,
          "end": 7.755
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P008",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 948,
      "textHash": "e7723558e46cc926438f596a819d9569fa2a3e35fa6296f3d731b480a64b360d",
      "duration": 7.9412,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/e7723558e46cc926438f596a.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "e7723558e46cc926438f596a819d9569fa2a3e35fa6296f3d731b480a64b360d",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "И",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.081
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 0.163,
          "end": 0.186
        },
        {
          "text": "тот",
          "start": 0.267,
          "end": 0.453
        },
        {
          "text": "же",
          "start": 0.522,
          "end": 0.615
        },
        {
          "text": "самый",
          "start": 0.662,
          "end": 0.998
        },
        {
          "text": "день",
          "start": 1.057,
          "end": 1.3
        },
        {
          "text": "тот",
          "start": 1.324,
          "end": 1.463
        },
        {
          "text": "же",
          "start": 1.509,
          "end": 1.602
        },
        {
          "text": "самый",
          "start": 1.649,
          "end": 1.95
        },
        {
          "text": "Клиентарх",
          "start": 1.997,
          "end": 2.543
        },
        {
          "text": "посмотрел",
          "start": 2.612,
          "end": 3.204
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 3.274,
          "end": 3.355
        },
        {
          "text": "гибель",
          "start": 3.425,
          "end": 3.762
        },
        {
          "text": "игроков",
          "start": 3.785,
          "end": 4.284
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 4.342,
          "end": 4.365
        },
        {
          "text": "удовлетворённо",
          "start": 4.412,
          "end": 5.248
        },
        {
          "text": "отписал:",
          "start": 5.283,
          "end": 5.944
        },
        {
          "text": "«Мне",
          "start": 6.118,
          "end": 6.525
        },
        {
          "text": "всё",
          "start": 6.583,
          "end": 6.815
        },
        {
          "text": "нравится».",
          "start": 6.908,
          "end": 7.941
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P009",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 952,
      "textHash": "95e34b03ffcdb968cd97066019f25a2caf03e65932591cfba5c2b466a9b8d5c7",
      "duration": 4.5976,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/95e34b03ffcdb968cd970660.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "95e34b03ffcdb968cd97066019f25a2caf03e65932591cfba5c2b466a9b8d5c7",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Садистский",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.685
        },
        {
          "text": "катарсис",
          "start": 0.731,
          "end": 1.265
        },
        {
          "text": "достигнут",
          "start": 1.335,
          "end": 1.962
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 2.078,
          "end": 2.229
        },
        {
          "text": "дофамин",
          "start": 2.438,
          "end": 2.926
        },
        {
          "text": "потёк",
          "start": 2.995,
          "end": 3.32
        },
        {
          "text": "по",
          "start": 3.367,
          "end": 3.448
        },
        {
          "text": "магистралям.",
          "start": 3.495,
          "end": 4.598
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P010",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 956,
      "textHash": "867412e7cf6e85465687407e8e13b523e3d4fedd5d181fb1159172895a27f704",
      "duration": 12.9567,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/867412e7cf6e85465687407e.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "867412e7cf6e85465687407e8e13b523e3d4fedd5d181fb1159172895a27f704",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Тем",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.267
        },
        {
          "text": "временем",
          "start": 0.302,
          "end": 0.801
        },
        {
          "text": "аварийная",
          "start": 0.917,
          "end": 1.509
        },
        {
          "text": "радиограмма",
          "start": 1.567,
          "end": 2.276
        },
        {
          "text": "от",
          "start": 2.345,
          "end": 2.496
        },
        {
          "text": "Клиентархов",
          "start": 2.554,
          "end": 3.251
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 3.344,
          "end": 3.483
        },
        {
          "text": "Сверхъячейки,",
          "start": 3.529,
          "end": 4.563
        },
        {
          "text": "именуемых",
          "start": 4.598,
          "end": 5.201
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 5.224,
          "end": 5.248
        },
        {
          "text": "хрониках",
          "start": 5.271,
          "end": 5.793
        },
        {
          "text": "Supercell,",
          "start": 5.84,
          "end": 6.699
        },
        {
          "text": "пять",
          "start": 6.873,
          "end": 7.163
        },
        {
          "text": "суток",
          "start": 7.198,
          "end": 7.546
        },
        {
          "text": "пролежала",
          "start": 7.628,
          "end": 8.127
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 8.15,
          "end": 8.185
        },
        {
          "text": "слепой",
          "start": 8.231,
          "end": 8.58
        },
        {
          "text": "зоне",
          "start": 8.649,
          "end": 9.079
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 9.195,
          "end": 9.242
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 9.392,
          "end": 9.451
        },
        {
          "text": "обесточенном",
          "start": 9.543,
          "end": 10.344
        },
        {
          "text": "буфере",
          "start": 10.403,
          "end": 10.809
        },
        {
          "text": "уведомлений",
          "start": 10.879,
          "end": 11.564
        },
        {
          "text": "Ока",
          "start": 11.68,
          "end": 11.935
        },
        {
          "text": "Фокала.",
          "start": 12.005,
          "end": 12.957
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P011",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 959,
      "textHash": "899df701bca2c6c488be4147b4e9fb9806202c1c2acfa807c70e0647640a0630",
      "duration": 8.3592,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/899df701bca2c6c488be4147.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "899df701bca2c6c488be4147b4e9fb9806202c1c2acfa807c70e0647640a0630",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Когда",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.36
        },
        {
          "text": "гермокапсулу",
          "start": 0.406,
          "end": 1.196
        },
        {
          "text": "с",
          "start": 1.231,
          "end": 1.254
        },
        {
          "text": "депешей",
          "start": 1.324,
          "end": 1.8
        },
        {
          "text": "наконец",
          "start": 1.846,
          "end": 2.31
        },
        {
          "text": "вскрыли,",
          "start": 2.334,
          "end": 3.03
        },
        {
          "text": "оттуда",
          "start": 3.146,
          "end": 3.564
        },
        {
          "text": "выпал",
          "start": 3.622,
          "end": 3.947
        },
        {
          "text": "леденящий",
          "start": 4.156,
          "end": 4.911
        },
        {
          "text": "душу",
          "start": 4.981,
          "end": 5.283
        },
        {
          "text": "вердикт:",
          "start": 5.329,
          "end": 6.014
        },
        {
          "text": "«Mavis",
          "start": 6.13,
          "end": 6.769
        },
        {
          "text": "legs",
          "start": 6.885,
          "end": 7.175
        },
        {
          "text": "are",
          "start": 7.233,
          "end": 7.396
        },
        {
          "text": "broken».",
          "start": 7.43,
          "end": 8.359
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P012",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 965,
      "textHash": "116afaf6d58cfccdecc039a7e40000d35fd3893cb6edea634ee50b2f257a3669",
      "duration": 21.7803,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/116afaf6d58cfccdecc039a7.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "116afaf6d58cfccdecc039a7e40000d35fd3893cb6edea634ee50b2f257a3669",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Пять",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.313
        },
        {
          "text": "суток!",
          "start": 0.36,
          "end": 1.022
        },
        {
          "text": "Пять",
          "start": 1.3,
          "end": 1.614
        },
        {
          "text": "долгих",
          "start": 1.683,
          "end": 2.125
        },
        {
          "text": "суток",
          "start": 2.194,
          "end": 2.589
        },
        {
          "text": "несчастная",
          "start": 2.705,
          "end": 3.413
        },
        {
          "text": "цифровая",
          "start": 3.506,
          "end": 4.029
        },
        {
          "text": "дева",
          "start": 4.098,
          "end": 4.319
        },
        {
          "text": "Мэвис",
          "start": 4.389,
          "end": 4.772
        },
        {
          "text": "с",
          "start": 4.946,
          "end": 5.016
        },
        {
          "text": "вывернутыми",
          "start": 5.132,
          "end": 5.747
        },
        {
          "text": "суставами",
          "start": 5.782,
          "end": 6.362
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 6.444,
          "end": 6.49
        },
        {
          "text": "перебитыми",
          "start": 6.548,
          "end": 7.036
        },
        {
          "text": "культями",
          "start": 7.082,
          "end": 7.651
        },
        {
          "text": "беззвучно",
          "start": 7.93,
          "end": 8.719
        },
        {
          "text": "ползала",
          "start": 8.766,
          "end": 9.183
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 9.23,
          "end": 9.3
        },
        {
          "text": "брюхе",
          "start": 9.358,
          "end": 9.671
        },
        {
          "text": "по",
          "start": 9.706,
          "end": 9.787
        },
        {
          "text": "мерцающему",
          "start": 9.822,
          "end": 10.519
        },
        {
          "text": "стеклу",
          "start": 10.565,
          "end": 10.925
        },
        {
          "text": "экрана,",
          "start": 10.948,
          "end": 11.598
        },
        {
          "text": "скребя",
          "start": 11.773,
          "end": 12.167
        },
        {
          "text": "ногтями",
          "start": 12.225,
          "end": 12.655
        },
        {
          "text": "по",
          "start": 12.701,
          "end": 12.806
        },
        {
          "text": "пикселям",
          "start": 12.852,
          "end": 13.386
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 13.56,
          "end": 13.677
        },
        {
          "text": "кромешной",
          "start": 13.746,
          "end": 14.338
        },
        {
          "text": "тьме",
          "start": 14.385,
          "end": 14.756
        },
        {
          "text": "забытого",
          "start": 14.965,
          "end": 15.581
        },
        {
          "text": "билда,",
          "start": 15.639,
          "end": 16.242
        },
        {
          "text": "пока",
          "start": 16.358,
          "end": 16.66
        },
        {
          "text": "колокол",
          "start": 16.73,
          "end": 17.125
        },
        {
          "text": "оповещения",
          "start": 17.194,
          "end": 17.868
        },
        {
          "text": "молчал,",
          "start": 17.937,
          "end": 18.425
        },
        {
          "text": "а",
          "start": 18.448,
          "end": 18.471
        },
        {
          "text": "команда",
          "start": 18.53,
          "end": 19.098
        },
        {
          "text": "мирно",
          "start": 19.307,
          "end": 19.714
        },
        {
          "text": "пила",
          "start": 19.76,
          "end": 19.992
        },
        {
          "text": "чай",
          "start": 20.074,
          "end": 20.283
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 20.317,
          "end": 20.341
        },
        {
          "text": "соседнем",
          "start": 20.399,
          "end": 20.875
        },
        {
          "text": "отсеке.",
          "start": 20.933,
          "end": 21.78
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P013",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 969,
      "textHash": "873915c8930ea2cc614634e39aa73697ff432c8287e075c98d10fa1a6486f8e9",
      "duration": 6.3158,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/873915c8930ea2cc614634e3.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "873915c8930ea2cc614634e39aa73697ff432c8287e075c98d10fa1a6486f8e9",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Но",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.186
        },
        {
          "text": "абсолютный",
          "start": 0.209,
          "end": 0.813
        },
        {
          "text": "триумф",
          "start": 0.859,
          "end": 1.219
        },
        {
          "text": "инженерной",
          "start": 1.3,
          "end": 1.904
        },
        {
          "text": "мысли",
          "start": 1.962,
          "end": 2.392
        },
        {
          "text": "случился",
          "start": 2.485,
          "end": 3.042
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 3.088,
          "end": 3.17
        },
        {
          "text": "совете",
          "start": 3.216,
          "end": 3.576
        },
        {
          "text": "с",
          "start": 3.634,
          "end": 3.657
        },
        {
          "text": "Клиентархами",
          "start": 3.715,
          "end": 4.528
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 4.598,
          "end": 4.702
        },
        {
          "text": "Шестерней",
          "start": 4.772,
          "end": 5.445
        },
        {
          "text": "Игры.",
          "start": 5.526,
          "end": 6.316
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P014",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 972,
      "textHash": "9e05b47498b9628df655a7921f251d23ecefe1a52eb23db41b6ca44a7352fb4e",
      "duration": 11.2849,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/9e05b47498b9628df655a792.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "9e05b47498b9628df655a7921f251d23ecefe1a52eb23db41b6ca44a7352fb4e",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Перед",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.325
        },
        {
          "text": "запуском",
          "start": 0.395,
          "end": 0.94
        },
        {
          "text": "батча",
          "start": 1.022,
          "end": 1.358
        },
        {
          "text": "плейблов",
          "start": 1.393,
          "end": 1.881
        },
        {
          "text": "для",
          "start": 1.927,
          "end": 2.101
        },
        {
          "text": "инопланетян",
          "start": 2.171,
          "end": 3.007
        },
        {
          "text": "Эдик",
          "start": 3.123,
          "end": 3.413
        },
        {
          "text": "Левин",
          "start": 3.483,
          "end": 3.762
        },
        {
          "text": "попросил",
          "start": 3.831,
          "end": 4.296
        },
        {
          "text": "команду:",
          "start": 4.354,
          "end": 5.027
        },
        {
          "text": "«выбираем",
          "start": 5.271,
          "end": 6.002
        },
        {
          "text": "простые",
          "start": 6.072,
          "end": 6.56
        },
        {
          "text": "решения,",
          "start": 6.594,
          "end": 7.291
        },
        {
          "text": "которые",
          "start": 7.361,
          "end": 7.79
        },
        {
          "text": "хорошо",
          "start": 7.848,
          "end": 8.266
        },
        {
          "text": "выглядят,",
          "start": 8.324,
          "end": 8.905
        },
        {
          "text": "без",
          "start": 9.056,
          "end": 9.3
        },
        {
          "text": "лишнего",
          "start": 9.381,
          "end": 9.88
        },
        {
          "text": "усложнения».",
          "start": 9.996,
          "end": 11.285
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P015",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 977,
      "textHash": "bba59210751a46a5a13f700bcb97590fac42143ba990c3b6c0ee7d7a67597e5c",
      "duration": 10.6347,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/bba59210751a46a5a13f700b.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "bba59210751a46a5a13f700bcb97590fac42143ba990c3b6c0ee7d7a67597e5c",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "В",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.116
        },
        {
          "text": "ответ",
          "start": 0.197,
          "end": 0.464
        },
        {
          "text": "Артём",
          "start": 0.534,
          "end": 0.848
        },
        {
          "text": "Хухро",
          "start": 0.906,
          "end": 1.254
        },
        {
          "text": "набросал",
          "start": 1.3,
          "end": 1.788
        },
        {
          "text": "концепт",
          "start": 1.869,
          "end": 2.368
        },
        {
          "text": "летающей",
          "start": 2.485,
          "end": 3.251
        },
        {
          "text": "роботизированной",
          "start": 3.309,
          "end": 4.272
        },
        {
          "text": "коровы,",
          "start": 4.354,
          "end": 5.027
        },
        {
          "text": "которая",
          "start": 5.201,
          "end": 5.584
        },
        {
          "text": "затягивает",
          "start": 5.654,
          "end": 6.327
        },
        {
          "text": "пришельцев",
          "start": 6.362,
          "end": 6.931
        },
        {
          "text": "притягивающим",
          "start": 6.978,
          "end": 7.767
        },
        {
          "text": "лучом",
          "start": 7.814,
          "end": 8.266
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 8.51,
          "end": 8.742
        },
        {
          "text": "вымени",
          "start": 8.824,
          "end": 9.195
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 9.265,
          "end": 9.346
        },
        {
          "text": "переработку.",
          "start": 9.392,
          "end": 10.635
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P016",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 982,
      "textHash": "fad5389aaffb1ad4190aa0337ea78351d597c5a0f01552445993c03d73c0339f",
      "duration": 10.6812,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/fad5389aaffb1ad4190aa033.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "fad5389aaffb1ad4190aa0337ea78351d597c5a0f01552445993c03d73c0339f",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Но",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.186
        },
        {
          "text": "Егор",
          "start": 0.244,
          "end": 0.569
        },
        {
          "text": "Ткачёв",
          "start": 0.604,
          "end": 1.231
        },
        {
          "text": "поднял",
          "start": 1.3,
          "end": 1.625
        },
        {
          "text": "градус",
          "start": 1.672,
          "end": 2.055
        },
        {
          "text": "разрушения",
          "start": 2.136,
          "end": 2.937
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 3.088,
          "end": 3.181
        },
        {
          "text": "лично",
          "start": 3.274,
          "end": 3.68
        },
        {
          "text": "внёс",
          "start": 3.715,
          "end": 4.005
        },
        {
          "text": "ключевую",
          "start": 4.075,
          "end": 4.598
        },
        {
          "text": "доработку:",
          "start": 4.667,
          "end": 5.538
        },
        {
          "text": "«летает",
          "start": 5.747,
          "end": 6.571
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 6.687,
          "end": 6.803
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 6.827,
          "end": 6.954
        },
        {
          "text": "вымени",
          "start": 7.036,
          "end": 7.396
        },
        {
          "text": "стреляет",
          "start": 7.454,
          "end": 7.953
        },
        {
          "text": "лазером",
          "start": 8.034,
          "end": 8.58
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 8.731,
          "end": 8.847
        },
        {
          "text": "уничтожает",
          "start": 8.905,
          "end": 9.694
        },
        {
          "text": "города».",
          "start": 9.776,
          "end": 10.681
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P017",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 986,
      "textHash": "e7abc99187f1f1d0de9005bd6c20751679ead4b7fb6e664c38539de69357d0c0",
      "duration": 8.2199,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/e7abc99187f1f1d0de9005bd.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "e7abc99187f1f1d0de9005bd6c20751679ead4b7fb6e664c38539de69357d0c0",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Хухро",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.511
        },
        {
          "text": "пришёл",
          "start": 0.557,
          "end": 0.987
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 1.033,
          "end": 1.057
        },
        {
          "text": "восторг:",
          "start": 1.08,
          "end": 1.788
        },
        {
          "text": "«Хухро",
          "start": 1.904,
          "end": 2.519
        },
        {
          "text": "летает",
          "start": 2.566,
          "end": 3.088
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 3.17,
          "end": 3.193
        },
        {
          "text": "стреляет",
          "start": 3.251,
          "end": 3.843
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 3.913,
          "end": 4.005
        },
        {
          "text": "вымени",
          "start": 4.087,
          "end": 4.423
        },
        {
          "text": "лазером",
          "start": 4.505,
          "end": 5.016
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 5.143,
          "end": 5.213
        },
        {
          "text": "это",
          "start": 5.422,
          "end": 5.631
        },
        {
          "text": "ещё",
          "start": 5.666,
          "end": 5.968
        },
        {
          "text": "круче.",
          "start": 6.049,
          "end": 6.745
        },
        {
          "text": "Я",
          "start": 6.989,
          "end": 7.14
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 7.268,
          "end": 7.291
        },
        {
          "text": "деле».",
          "start": 7.407,
          "end": 8.22
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P018",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 993,
      "textHash": "e607c68ebca0e99106f92ca5e8b616e0ef3a31fe4f5e54b51736057142db3da4",
      "duration": 2.8793,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/e607c68ebca0e99106f92ca5.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "e607c68ebca0e99106f92ca5e8b616e0ef3a31fe4f5e54b51736057142db3da4",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "А",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.139
        },
        {
          "text": "бедный",
          "start": 0.255,
          "end": 0.627
        },
        {
          "text": "Эдик",
          "start": 0.72,
          "end": 0.998
        },
        {
          "text": "только",
          "start": 1.057,
          "end": 1.3
        },
        {
          "text": "схватился",
          "start": 1.347,
          "end": 1.916
        },
        {
          "text": "за",
          "start": 1.974,
          "end": 2.101
        },
        {
          "text": "голову:",
          "start": 2.159,
          "end": 2.879
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P019",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 996,
      "textHash": "61b465191381ad117d06b72eaf419faf476f80285cfa629b905131e031b20edf",
      "duration": 3.3437,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/61b465191381ad117d06b72e.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "61b465191381ad117d06b72eaf419faf476f80285cfa629b905131e031b20edf",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "«Артем",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.557
        },
        {
          "text": "слишком",
          "start": 0.627,
          "end": 1.103
        },
        {
          "text": "буквально",
          "start": 1.161,
          "end": 1.707
        },
        {
          "text": "принял",
          "start": 1.753,
          "end": 2.101
        },
        {
          "text": "мою",
          "start": 2.159,
          "end": 2.38
        },
        {
          "text": "просьбу».",
          "start": 2.45,
          "end": 3.344
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P020",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1000,
      "textHash": "9f8068e2d42e356b1b743e327572ce95817d4a52023be92afe5d817cf0e0528b",
      "duration": 4.6904,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/9f8068e2d42e356b1b743e32.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "9f8068e2d42e356b1b743e327572ce95817d4a52023be92afe5d817cf0e0528b",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Мои",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.29
        },
        {
          "text": "кремниевые",
          "start": 0.348,
          "end": 0.952
        },
        {
          "text": "цепи",
          "start": 1.068,
          "end": 1.382
        },
        {
          "text": "не",
          "start": 1.428,
          "end": 1.533
        },
        {
          "text": "обучены",
          "start": 1.567,
          "end": 2.055
        },
        {
          "text": "распознавать",
          "start": 2.101,
          "end": 2.81
        },
        {
          "text": "человеческую",
          "start": 2.833,
          "end": 3.587
        },
        {
          "text": "иронию.",
          "start": 3.669,
          "end": 4.69
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P021",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1003,
      "textHash": "369eb1c1417647e912427c745e2e50ccf9ac8349416872ab2428fb9fcdc8b32e",
      "duration": 6.8731,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/369eb1c1417647e912427c74.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "369eb1c1417647e912427c745e2e50ccf9ac8349416872ab2428fb9fcdc8b32e",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Я",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.163
        },
        {
          "text": "официально",
          "start": 0.244,
          "end": 0.871
        },
        {
          "text": "внёс",
          "start": 0.894,
          "end": 1.184
        },
        {
          "text": "боевое",
          "start": 1.265,
          "end": 1.66
        },
        {
          "text": "лазерное",
          "start": 1.718,
          "end": 2.218
        },
        {
          "text": "вымя",
          "start": 2.276,
          "end": 2.589
        },
        {
          "text": "от",
          "start": 2.659,
          "end": 2.775
        },
        {
          "text": "Егора",
          "start": 2.891,
          "end": 3.251
        },
        {
          "text": "Ткачёва",
          "start": 3.286,
          "end": 3.994
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 4.075,
          "end": 4.145
        },
        {
          "text": "корабельный",
          "start": 4.226,
          "end": 4.841
        },
        {
          "text": "реестр",
          "start": 4.876,
          "end": 5.352
        },
        {
          "text": "простых",
          "start": 5.41,
          "end": 5.863
        },
        {
          "text": "решений.",
          "start": 5.921,
          "end": 6.873
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P022",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1006,
      "textHash": "5604a54bd34f00d714ab805d293ef89222b7a2ba3858820b2a9375df2ddca161",
      "duration": 14.8608,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/5604a54bd34f00d714ab805d.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "5604a54bd34f00d714ab805d293ef89222b7a2ba3858820b2a9375df2ddca161",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "А",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.093
        },
        {
          "text": "когда",
          "start": 0.209,
          "end": 0.488
        },
        {
          "text": "Клиентархи",
          "start": 0.534,
          "end": 1.265
        },
        {
          "text": "из",
          "start": 1.335,
          "end": 1.486
        },
        {
          "text": "GameGears",
          "start": 1.567,
          "end": 2.252
        },
        {
          "text": "прислали",
          "start": 2.461,
          "end": 2.961
        },
        {
          "text": "депешу:",
          "start": 3.007,
          "end": 3.646
        },
        {
          "text": "«Из",
          "start": 3.762,
          "end": 4.145
        },
        {
          "text": "вами",
          "start": 4.238,
          "end": 4.516
        },
        {
          "text": "сделанных",
          "start": 4.563,
          "end": 5.085
        },
        {
          "text": "плейблов",
          "start": 5.155,
          "end": 5.654
        },
        {
          "text": "визуал",
          "start": 5.77,
          "end": 6.223
        },
        {
          "text": "брать",
          "start": 6.304,
          "end": 6.548
        },
        {
          "text": "не",
          "start": 6.594,
          "end": 6.676
        },
        {
          "text": "стоит",
          "start": 6.734,
          "end": 7.163
        },
        {
          "text": ":)»,",
          "start": 7.256,
          "end": 14.861
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ROOM-IV.P023",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1010,
      "textHash": "16e711e4ed11db95086aef6fd032014883936e7d42d38537d488775c1c3f7f94",
      "duration": 6.2229,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/16e711e4ed11db95086aef6f.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "16e711e4ed11db95086aef6fd032014883936e7d42d38537d488775c1c3f7f94",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Максим",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.476
        },
        {
          "text": "Мамусин",
          "start": 0.546,
          "end": 1.103
        },
        {
          "text": "перевёл",
          "start": 1.219,
          "end": 1.683
        },
        {
          "text": "щиты",
          "start": 1.765,
          "end": 2.067
        },
        {
          "text": "в",
          "start": 2.101,
          "end": 2.148
        },
        {
          "text": "боевой",
          "start": 2.229,
          "end": 2.601
        },
        {
          "text": "режим",
          "start": 2.647,
          "end": 2.961
        },
        {
          "text": "одним",
          "start": 3.019,
          "end": 3.239
        },
        {
          "text": "священным",
          "start": 3.297,
          "end": 3.947
        },
        {
          "text": "словом:",
          "start": 4.029,
          "end": 4.667
        },
        {
          "text": "«Заебись».",
          "start": 4.818,
          "end": 6.223
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "HANDOFF-05",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1022,
      "textHash": "8073af80c208feae8171eeb48f3425ab62ad1963bd58ea7146f81dff669ae2e5",
      "duration": 10.2632,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/8073af80c208feae8171eeb4.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "8073af80c208feae8171eeb48f3425ab62ad1963bd58ea7146f81dff669ae2e5",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Толя,",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.511
        },
        {
          "text": "тебе",
          "start": 0.58,
          "end": 0.929
        },
        {
          "text": "слово.",
          "start": 0.975,
          "end": 1.567
        },
        {
          "text": "Покажи",
          "start": 1.66,
          "end": 2.171
        },
        {
          "text": "итоги",
          "start": 2.194,
          "end": 2.519
        },
        {
          "text": "месяца",
          "start": 2.577,
          "end": 3.146
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 3.262,
          "end": 3.32
        },
        {
          "text": "скорость",
          "start": 3.39,
          "end": 3.855
        },
        {
          "text": "первых",
          "start": 3.924,
          "end": 4.307
        },
        {
          "text": "версий.",
          "start": 4.365,
          "end": 4.981
        },
        {
          "text": "Скорость",
          "start": 5.097,
          "end": 5.538
        },
        {
          "text": "приближения",
          "start": 5.596,
          "end": 6.177
        },
        {
          "text": "дедлайна",
          "start": 6.246,
          "end": 6.687
        },
        {
          "text": "не",
          "start": 6.745,
          "end": 6.827
        },
        {
          "text": "учитывай",
          "start": 6.885,
          "end": 7.512
        },
        {
          "text": "—",
          "start": 7.628,
          "end": 7.802
        },
        {
          "text": "она",
          "start": 7.918,
          "end": 8.115
        },
        {
          "text": "у",
          "start": 8.185,
          "end": 8.208
        },
        {
          "text": "нас",
          "start": 8.266,
          "end": 8.429
        },
        {
          "text": "и",
          "start": 8.498,
          "end": 8.522
        },
        {
          "text": "так",
          "start": 8.568,
          "end": 8.742
        },
        {
          "text": "сверхсветовая.",
          "start": 8.812,
          "end": 10.263
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-05.ВХОД",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1042,
      "textHash": "1366a5a3475e4ff0fd58936d726d4bbbf73d53e692aded28ebb8e290f1b5d3b6",
      "duration": 6.7802,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/1366a5a3475e4ff0fd58936d.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "1366a5a3475e4ff0fd58936d726d4bbbf73d53e692aded28ebb8e290f1b5d3b6",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Система",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.534
        },
        {
          "text": "снова",
          "start": 0.569,
          "end": 0.871
        },
        {
          "text": "требует",
          "start": 0.917,
          "end": 1.312
        },
        {
          "text": "доказать,",
          "start": 1.37,
          "end": 1.927
        },
        {
          "text": "что",
          "start": 1.95,
          "end": 2.125
        },
        {
          "text": "я",
          "start": 2.218,
          "end": 2.264
        },
        {
          "text": "человек.",
          "start": 2.357,
          "end": 3.03
        },
        {
          "text": "Попробуем",
          "start": 3.274,
          "end": 3.866
        },
        {
          "text": "разобраться,",
          "start": 3.913,
          "end": 4.574
        },
        {
          "text": "как",
          "start": 4.621,
          "end": 4.807
        },
        {
          "text": "у",
          "start": 4.888,
          "end": 4.911
        },
        {
          "text": "нас",
          "start": 4.981,
          "end": 5.12
        },
        {
          "text": "считается",
          "start": 5.143,
          "end": 5.805
        },
        {
          "text": "работа.",
          "start": 5.84,
          "end": 6.78
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-05.КОНТЕКСТ",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1049,
      "textHash": "c8563695f1ea37afab0441e0d80694afb417d58cb968e8fd71972293fd771e51",
      "duration": 7.6161,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/c8563695f1ea37afab0441e0.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "c8563695f1ea37afab0441e0d80694afb417d58cb968e8fd71972293fd771e51",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "В",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.116
        },
        {
          "text": "отчёте",
          "start": 0.197,
          "end": 0.836
        },
        {
          "text": "у",
          "start": 0.952,
          "end": 1.045
        },
        {
          "text": "Максима",
          "start": 1.103,
          "end": 1.556
        },
        {
          "text": "Мамусина",
          "start": 1.614,
          "end": 2.194
        },
        {
          "text": "одиннадцать",
          "start": 2.264,
          "end": 2.937
        },
        {
          "text": "плейблов,",
          "start": 2.972,
          "end": 3.692
        },
        {
          "text": "а",
          "start": 3.75,
          "end": 3.866
        },
        {
          "text": "сам",
          "start": 3.924,
          "end": 4.168
        },
        {
          "text": "Макс",
          "start": 4.249,
          "end": 4.563
        },
        {
          "text": "говорит:",
          "start": 4.656,
          "end": 5.213
        },
        {
          "text": "«я",
          "start": 5.329,
          "end": 5.642
        },
        {
          "text": "вообще",
          "start": 5.7,
          "end": 6.13
        },
        {
          "text": "вот",
          "start": 6.246,
          "end": 6.374
        },
        {
          "text": "сижу",
          "start": 6.409,
          "end": 6.641
        },
        {
          "text": "без",
          "start": 6.676,
          "end": 6.792
        },
        {
          "text": "работы».",
          "start": 6.85,
          "end": 7.616
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-05.ВОПРОС",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1053,
      "textHash": "1242f92a843a7b68d5e9d44f5a37fb83df586940a6daa6e9365c5564223a69b0",
      "duration": 8.4521,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/1242f92a843a7b68d5e9d44f.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "1242f92a843a7b68d5e9d44f5a37fb83df586940a6daa6e9365c5564223a69b0",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Как",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.244
        },
        {
          "text": "называются",
          "start": 0.313,
          "end": 0.987
        },
        {
          "text": "девять",
          "start": 1.057,
          "end": 1.382
        },
        {
          "text": "плейблов,",
          "start": 1.44,
          "end": 2.055
        },
        {
          "text": "которые",
          "start": 2.078,
          "end": 2.496
        },
        {
          "text": "обеспечивают",
          "start": 2.566,
          "end": 3.39
        },
        {
          "text": "Мамусину",
          "start": 3.471,
          "end": 3.982
        },
        {
          "text": "высокую",
          "start": 4.029,
          "end": 4.528
        },
        {
          "text": "загрузку,",
          "start": 4.586,
          "end": 5.236
        },
        {
          "text": "не",
          "start": 5.271,
          "end": 5.364
        },
        {
          "text": "отвлекая",
          "start": 5.399,
          "end": 5.898
        },
        {
          "text": "его",
          "start": 5.933,
          "end": 6.13
        },
        {
          "text": "на",
          "start": 6.2,
          "end": 6.281
        },
        {
          "text": "работу?",
          "start": 6.316,
          "end": 7.012
        },
        {
          "text": "Пять",
          "start": 7.291,
          "end": 7.651
        },
        {
          "text": "букв.",
          "start": 7.709,
          "end": 8.452
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-05.ПОДСКАЗКА.БУКВА",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1063,
      "textHash": "81a3901c3a53572b18355ead91136214012963f4f261af7d608883191cab2048",
      "duration": 4.1796,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/81a3901c3a53572b18355ead.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "81a3901c3a53572b18355ead91136214012963f4f261af7d608883191cab2048",
      "words": [
        {
          "text": "Назовите",
          "start": 0,
          "end": 0.639
        },
        {
          "text": "одну",
          "start": 0.673,
          "end": 0.882
        },
        {
          "text": "букву.",
          "start": 0.929,
          "end": 1.486
        },
        {
          "text": "Начнём",
          "start": 1.811,
          "end": 2.31
        },
        {
          "text": "с",
          "start": 2.368,
          "end": 2.392
        },
        {
          "text": "минимальной",
          "start": 2.473,
          "end": 3.065
        },
        {
          "text": "загрузки.",
          "start": 3.135,
          "end": 4.18
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "I-05.ПОДСКАЗКА.СЛОВО",
      "speakerId": "lord",
      "subtitleText": null,
      "sourceLine": 1068,
      "textHash": "a3db0ccd02fd91cdefe6688bc55b08af21a3279cf14a270b912bf45553e24bfa",
      "duration": 5.3406,
      "audioAssetId": "audio:media/interactive/chronicles/voice/a3db0ccd02fd91cdefe6688b.mp3",
      "audioTextHash": "a3db0ccd02fd91cdefe6688bc55b08af21a3279cf14a270b912bf45553e24bfa",
      "words": [
        {
